vk-kingdom-turn-helper.title: Accelerate Project
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.noStructures: No structures are currently under construction.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.criticalSuccessMsg: Spectacular acceleration! You may spend RP up to {multiplier}× the Resource Die size ({maxRp} RP) toward completing this structure.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.successMsg: Successful acceleration! You may spend RP up to {multiplier}× the Resource Die size ({maxRp} RP) toward completing this structure.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.failureMsg: You fail to effectively accelerate the construction. No RP may be spent.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.criticalFailureMsg: Your efforts cause delays! During the Ongoing Construction step, reduce the RP you may spend on {structureName} by {penalty} RP (the Resource Die size).
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.rpSpent: Spent {amount} RP on {structure}. Construction is now {current}/{total} RP.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.noPf2eKingmakerTools: V&K Kingdom Turn Helper requires pf2e-kingmaker-tools to be active.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.noKingdomActor: No kingdom actor found. Open the Kingdom sheet first.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.resetConfirm: Reset the Accelerate Project turn tracking? This should be done at the start of a new kingdom turn.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.resetDone: Accelerate Project turn tracking has been reset.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.blessedChooseActivity: Choose a Kingdom skill activity to bless. If you select Build Structure, also specify the structure.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.blessedActive: Blessed Solution is active for {activity}! The +2 bonus and Folklore reroll will apply automatically.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.blessedFailure: Blessed Solution failed. {rp} RP spent in offerings with no blessing.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.blessedCritFail: Blessed Solution critical failure! {rp} RP lost and a 2-turn cooldown applied.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.blessedCooldown: Cannot use Blessed Solution — the spirits are still angered ({turns} turn(s) remaining).
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.foreignAidNoGroups: No groups with diplomatic relations found. Use Send Diplomatic Envoy first.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.foreignAidResetConfirm: Reset which groups have been requested this turn? This should be done at the start of a new kingdom turn.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.foreignAidResetDone: Foreign Aid turn tracking has been reset.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.observeCustomsChooseRuin: Choose a Ruin to increase by 1.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionLimitLine: V&K construction limit: up to {maxRp} RP per turn on a {category} structure (d{die} Resource Die{yard}).

vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionPartialShort: Pay {pay} of {total} RP now; construction continues on a later turn.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionComplete: Pay {pay} RP. The full cost fits within this turn's limit.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionPenaltyNote: Accelerate Project critical failure this turn: −{penalty} RP.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionSameTurnNote: A structure started with Build Structure this turn cannot receive Ongoing Construction until next turn.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionNoRpAllowed: No RP may be spent on {structure} during Ongoing Construction this turn.
vk-kingdom-turn-helper.constructionNotFound: Could not find that structure's data.
